Find differentially expressed ECM genes between groups

Source: R/differential-expression.R
find_ecm_markers.Rd

Identifies differentially expressed matrisome genes between two groups (clusters, conditions, etc.) using Seurat's FindMarkers framework.

Usage

find_ecm_markers(
  seurat_obj,
  ident.1,
  ident.2 = NULL,
  group.by = NULL,
  assay = NULL,
  test.use = "wilcox",
  min.pct = 0.05,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  categories = NULL,
  only.pos = FALSE,
  p.adjust.method = "BH",
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

seurat_obj

A Seurat object

ident.1

Identity of the first group (cluster name, cell names, or condition)

ident.2

Identity of the second group. If NULL, compares ident.1 vs all other cells.

group.by

Metadata column to use for grouping. If NULL, uses active identities.

assay

Assay to use. If NULL, auto-detects (SCT > Spatial > first available).

test.use

Statistical test: "wilcox" (default), "MAST", "DESeq2", "LR", "t"

min.pct

Minimum fraction of cells expressing the gene in either group (default: 0.05)

logfc.threshold

Minimum log2 fold change threshold (default: 0.25)

categories

Matrisome categories to include. Can be divisions ("Core matrisome") or subcategories ("Collagens"). If NULL, uses all ECM genes.

only.pos

Only return genes with positive log2FC (upregulated in ident.1)

p.adjust.method

Method for p-value adjustment (default: "BH")

verbose

Print progress messages

Value

Data frame with columns:

gene

Gene symbol

p_val

Raw p-value

avg_log2FC

Average log2 fold change

pct.1

Fraction of cells in ident.1 expressing the gene

pct.2

Fraction of cells in ident.2 expressing the gene

p_val_adj

Adjusted p-value

category

Matrisome division (Core/Associated)

subcategory

Matrisome subcategory

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Compare fibroblasts vs all other cells
markers <- find_ecm_markers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = "Fibroblasts",
                            group.by = "cell_type")

# Compare two specific clusters
markers <- find_ecm_markers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = "1", ident.2 = "2",
                            group.by = "seurat_clusters")

# Filter to collagens only
collagen_de <- find_ecm_markers(seurat_obj, ident.1 = "Stroma",
                                 categories = "Collagens")
} # }
